detail: The Croatian Employment Service gives no employment mediation to foreign job seekers unless they are permanent residents.
The Act on Employment Mediation and Unemployment Rights is to be amended before end 2007 for equal treatment by the employment office.
The Commission finds Croatia has reached a satisfactory level of alignment on free movement of workers overall.
